$doc: The texture pack, the file the cube kind's look is drawn from: one image
of every tile under asset/content/cube/, which the asset ingest composes
and ships as the table's file at this path, with which tile each cube
wears on which face (pxl-tool bin/ingest_asset.rs, pxl_spec::asset::ingested
What a cell shows when nothing painted it: a cell with nothing on it is
still land, as Carto's background is.

sentinel.name: void
$doc: nothing painted: the ground before a bake writes it, and an object cell no leaf holds

sentinel.name: unknown
$doc: bedrock, where the world holds no more: the floor under the ground and the wall just inside the service area (`pxl-spec block/limit.rs`); a cell past the area or the coverage, which no source here describes, reads as it and is drawn as nothing, as is a byte no bake wrote: 0xFF, so memory filled with 0xFF reads as unknown; nothing is placed on or taken from it
The ground: one byte a cell, a look from OpenStreetMap Carto, numbered in
`transport` marks a way: decor faces along it and no pier stands on it;
every look stands at its sampled height.

What only an object can be: past a byte, so no ground cell holds it. An
object's value is a u16 whose byte range is the ground's palette.

entries.name: air
